No NOAA or NCEI page checked says 'public domain' for these grids. The GHCN readme, the nClimGrid user guide and the daily and monthly nClimGrid readmes contain no licence or public-domain text. recommendation_note: Recommendation stands on its source choice: NOAA nClimGrid-Daily scaled monthly files for prcp, tmax and tmin on the 1/24-degree grid, with prelim only for newer days and labelled provisional. Counts (60 scaled months; 25,902 land cells; 4,568 tiles), sizes (56,872,702 bytes for June 2025; 3,548,877,305 bytes for the 60 months), the Billings and Benchland values, the airport comparison and the terms all reproduce. Fix before the build: (1) cell size wording (4.6 km north-south, about 3 km east-west); (2) daily-run cost (about 1.8 MB per new day); (3) stored values are unrounded, so sums use rounded daily values (Billings June 47.69 mm; July 43.01 mm); (4) airport coordinates (45.8072 N, 108.5461 W); (5) the NODD sentence and 17 U.S.C. 105 and 101 as the basis for the public-domain label, with About-page wording that does not say 'public domain' unless the owner accepts that basis; (6) the 'rule 7' cross-reference. Open: tile byte totals (not on disk), the monthly sums beyond June and July, the Sept 2026 prelim-vs-scaled gap, the monthly row order, and the 2025 snow total (no quality flags, but far above other years; needs a second source).
